Making an incredible giant döner using ostrich meat! 🦤🔥🥙

Thin slices of uniquely lean ostrich meat are slowly roasted on a vertical spit, creating beautifully browned edges and a delicious smoky flavor. Ostrich is notably lean and is commonly prepared with quick, high-heat grilling techniques, making this giant döner a truly unusual cooking experience.

A spectacular outdoor recipe for anyone who loves giant food, fire cooking and discovering unusual flavors!
